items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Yeah they were out in the park one time when Piku played.

ctx.x: I knew they had some quadrilles dancers at one of the Creole festivals.
Right. Those are the people I am speaking about. Same group. Yeah they were out in the park one time when Piku played. Yeah that's right. At Burry Guard Square. At Burry Guard Square. Yeah.
They had a television program with Dave Garroway about three years ago. And then Lizzie Miles and Paula Barberin's band and all of that. They had the group then. Now she dances that too Lizzie Miles.
